name: space-analyser
description: Find everything on your Mac and reclaim storage

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Space Analyser reads file sizes on your Desktop to show what uses storage.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Space Analyser reads file sizes in your Documents folder to show what uses storage.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Space Analyser reads file sizes in your Downloads folder to show what uses storage.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Space Analyser reads file sizes on removable volumes to show what uses storage.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Space Analyser reads file sizes on network volumes to show what uses storage.
